jobs.title: Digital Producer
jobs.reason: Requires a minimum of 5 years creating digital e-learning content plus 3 years managing educational projects — well beyond entry-level and a hard experience disqualifier. It also demands e-learning production expertise the candidate lacks, and the role sits outside all interest zones.

jobs.title: Aerospace Auditor
jobs.reason: This is a specialist aerospace quality-management auditor role requiring deep sector expertise in AS9100/ISO 9001 assessment and the ability to lead assessment teams — experience the candidate plainly lacks and well beyond entry level. It sits entirely outside all three interest zones and offers no paper fit.

jobs.title: Customer Service Team Leader
jobs.reason: A "Team Leader" role that essentially requires people-management experience within a client-service environment — clearly not entry-level and beyond the candidate's student-assistant background. It is also a customer-service administration function with no connection to any of the candidate's interest zones.

jobs.title: Food Safety Auditor (USA)
jobs.reason: This is an on-demand food safety/health-and-safety auditing contractor role requiring practical audit and inspection expertise entirely outside the candidate's research and policy profile, so paper fit is very weak. It sits in none of the candidate's interest zones and offers no meaningful skills transfer, making it barely worth surfacing.
jobs.location: Houston / various US states (North/South Carolina, Florida, Nevada, Hawaii, Northern California)
